To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Swedish PET bottle-to-bottle system is more advanced than the German system and that there is a lack of bottle-to-bottle quality in Germany.
the Swedish PET bottle-to-bottle system is currently the best practice in Europe.

the main barriers for closed-loop systems in PET bottle recycling are (1) low bottle quality, (2) lack of regulations, (3) lack of recollection systems, (4), lack of market demand for bottle grade material and (5) low consumer awareness.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the current PET bottle recycling systems and their barriers and enhancements.
the development of a theoretical framework for the analysis of the barriers and enhancements of bottle-to-bottle systems.
a managerial perspective on the PET bottle-to-bottle systems in Germany and in Sweden and provides recommendations for future research and practical implications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a bottle-to-bottle system in Germany and Sweden is possible, but it requires a holistic approach with the commitment of all actors.
the German PET bottle recycling system needs a holistic approach to overcome the current barriers.
a bottle-to-bottle system is a complex system with many factors that influence it and that a holistic view of these factors and their interaction is essential for the implementation of such a system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the PET bottle recycling system in Sweden is superior to the German system and can serve as a role model for other countries.
the PET bottle-to-bottle system in Sweden has the potential to be improved by the enhancements and further recommendations.
the PET bottle recycling system in Germany should be improved by a unified system, which is based on the Swedish model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the bottle-to-bottle system is not only a technical system but also a social system.
the bottle-to-bottle systems in Germany and in Sweden can be enhanced by the implementation of our recommendations.
closed-loop recycling systems can be improved through the implementation of the identified enhancements and recommendations.
